{"claims":[{"claim_text":"DSA’s National Political Committee (NPC) approved this statement.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA is committed to the full decolonization of Hawai’i, Puerto Rico, Amerika Sāmoa, Guåhån, Northern Mariana Islands, and Virgin Islands.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA is committed to the full decolonization of all indigenous nations whose ancestral lands are within current U.S. borders.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA is committed to the independence of all other overseas territories and dependencies controlled, occupied, or otherwise exploited by the USA.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA will work to build a movement in solidarity with and alongside oppressed peoples and their political formations, conscious and respectful of their leadership and organization, against all forms of colonialism and imperialism.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"DSA will establish a Decolonization Working Group to facilitate anti-imperialist and decolonization politics within the organization.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"DSA will work to overturn the Insular Cases (1901) that created the colonial status of the territories acquired from Spain following the Spanish-American War and all other laws and legal rulings that maintain the colonial status quo.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[6]},{"claim_text":"DSA will work for the release of all political prisoners incarcerated for their resistance to U.S. imperialism.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[6]}],"unresolved_references":[]}

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"DSA will establish a Decolonization Working Group to facilitate anti-imperialist and decolonization politics within the organization.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"DSA will work to overturn the Insular Cases (1901) that created the colonial status of the territories acquired from Spain following the Spanish-American War and all other laws and legal rulings that maintain the colonial status quo.",
